messages:
Alex (Sales): Quick sync—POC readout prep for NovaRetail tomorrow 11am PT. Need final metrics, contract ask, and any outstanding security Qs.
Maria (Solutions Eng): Thanks—final evals attached in thread: precision@k, latency percentiles. I'll paste summary below.
Ben (Eng): Perf numbers: p99=420ms on dedicated, median=60ms, tokens/sec=1200. Used batching=dynamic-4.
Maria (Solutions Eng): Success criteria we agreed: 1) inference latency < 500ms p95; 2) semantic accuracy > 0.78 on eval set (see prompt suite); 3) cost per 1k tokens <$1.50; 4) no infra incidents during run.
Sophie (Product): Customer cares about hallucination rate. Our eval: hallucination (false facts) 4.1% on 2k prompt set. Need mitigation plan.
Kevin (CSM): Pricing ask: they want committed monthly reserved capacity. Need ballpark for 4x nvidia A10-equivalents.
Alex (Sales): Ballpark quote: $X/month reserved + variable. Maria, can you propose a Dedicated config + uplift for SLA?
Maria (Solutions Eng): Proposed: 4x rtx6000-q where a dedicated pool with autoscale up to 6. Pricing uplift +20% for SLA. I'll follow up with numbers.
Ben (Eng): Noted perf gap for longer context (8k tokens) — p95 jumps to 1.2s. We recommend KV cache and quantization profile 'q4_0' to reduce latency.
Maria (Solutions Eng): Security questionnaire: customer flagged data residency. We're cleared for eu-west-1 only. legal-bot: see attached SSO/KMS answers.
legal-bot: SAML, SCIM yes; KMS integration supported with customer-managed keys; SOC2 report link: https://redwood.internal/compliance/soc2
Sophie (Product): Readout deck should include: 1) top-line metrics, 2) failure modes, 3) plan & timeline for rollouts, 4) expansion ask (multi-model routing + fine-tuning trial).
Alex (Sales): OK. For tomorrow's readout let's present: metrics slide (use these numbers), open blockers slide (security + long-context perf), ask slide (3-month pilot -> Dedicated + Professional Services for prompt tuning).
Kevin (CSM): Next steps: 1) send revised quote by EOD today, 2) send security Q answers, 3) schedule a 30m decision call mid-next-week.
Ben (Eng): Will add runbook for fallback routing to smaller models in case of capacity issues.
Maria (Solutions Eng): I'll paste concise metrics for the deck:
```
- Latency (p50/p95/p99): 60ms / 480ms / 920ms
- Throughput: 1.2k tokens/sec (per GPU), 4 GPUs pooled
- Eval accuracy (semantic sim): 0.79
- Hallucination rate: 4.1%
- Cost per 1k tokens (hosted): $1.34
```
Alex (Sales): Perfect. Anyone object to the expansion ask: reserved 4 GPU pool + 20h PS + 1 mo fine-tune credit?
Sophie (Product): +1
Kevin (CSM): +1
Ben (Eng): +1 pending / latency mitigations
Maria (Solutions Eng): Sending quote and security pack now. Attaching prompt set and eval results link: https://redwood.internal/poc/1769456789/evals
Alex (Sales): Thanks team — I'll run the readout and capture decision. :thumbsup:
